verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a cloud platform with an official CLI and SDKs, so the axis applies. However, no item in the evidence pack documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out for Azure, its CLI, or its client libraries. The CLI and Cost Management citations cover installation and cost/usage billing data, not telemetry collection.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
